title: Visible Medicine completion checklist
purpose: Track the full website and Atlas roadmap, owner clinical inputs and optional product ideas without equating drafts or tests with clinical completion.

baseline.websiteWorkingTree: Intentionally dirty; complete source composition is separately hash-verified in local recovery.
baseline.limitations: Overlapping source representations and topic placements, not unique lessons, complete anatomy, acquired-image coverage, private approval counts or a completion percentage. Private clinical decisions were not read. Atlas resource registry counts do not measure the separate website's native CT/MRI integration.

pendingAtlasSource.note: Four exact-source abdominal venous radial-EUS Ultrasound drafts imported coherently. Acquisition-specific operator observations, not routine transabdominal visibility, a cohort detection rate, patency, full-course anatomy or patient registration. Other9,932 displayed topics/1104 identities/109 model bundles remain exact; only two targets belong to the1022-record archival export. No new media/dependencies/geometry, approval transfer, acquired scans or public release.

statusDefinitions.verified-local: Bounded software or inventory criterion has local evidence; separate clinical, browser and release items remain open.
statusDefinitions.partial: A working foundation exists but the stated acceptance criterion is incomplete.
statusDefinitions.open: Useful work can proceed; completion is not proven.
statusDefinitions.needs-owner: Owner decision, clinical input, approved data or operational authority is required for this item only.
statusDefinitions.held: Source identity, condition, rights or spatial evidence prevents safe admission; prepare independent work without removing the hold.
statusDefinitions.proposed: Optional idea for assessment; not added to mandatory completion scope.
statusDefinitions.done: Exact acceptance evidence, scope, date and completion record are saved. Clinical approval must be separately recorded by the authorized human.

rules: Stable IDs survive reordering. Split an item into linked child IDs when necessary; do not silently delete scope.
Update status, exact source/revision, evidence and dated change log after each verified milestone.
Recheck stale evidence after a relevant source, renderer, case or contract change; never migrate approval automatically.
Report counts by status, owner and area; optional ideas are separate. Do not calculate an overall completion percentage from unequal items.
An owner-gated item does not stop independent engineering, teaching drafts or review preparation.
No patient data, private review notes, images, identifiers, credentials or uncleared derivatives belong in this checklist or GitHub.
Public deployment, billing, permissions, privacy clearance and clinical sign-off require their own authorization and evidence.

items.task: Finish distributed asset and licence release audit
items.acceptance: Audit exact shipped dependency/font/mesh/texture/image/content bytes and notices, retain attribution, resolve source holds and confirm no mandatory paid dependency. Classification reports are not exhaustive rights clearance or a forever-free hosting guarantee.

items.task: Approve image/privacy/publication clearance per release
items.acceptance: Owner/governance records exact case/derivative privacy, rights, facial/de-identification considerations and intended audience; source approval for local use is not silently treated as upload permission.

items.task: Choose and authorize the real private deployment target
items.acceptance: Confirm domain/origin, approved education identity, access policy, storage/transport, operational owners and a cost ceiling; perform private deployment/readback only when authorized. Public and paid activation remain separate decisions.

items.task: Complete security and account-lifecycle assurance
items.acceptance: Threat review plus genuine authentication/authorization, tenant boundaries, upload screening, rate limits, secrets, export/deletion and incident exercises pass on the intended environment; do not bypass authentication to test.

items.task: Supply approved legal, support and commercial details
items.acceptance: Approve legal entity/contact, terms, privacy, accessibility, retention and support processes. Paid launch additionally needs pricing, contracts, tax, invoice/refund and entitlement decisions before enabling billing.

items.task: Verify complete website and operational backups
items.acceptance: Keep current Atlas-only GitHub source and scoped F recovery verified; establish an authorized sanitized website backup and separate private data/database recovery with an actual restore exercise. Never call the Atlas mirror a full website/private-data/off-device backup.

items.task: Finish transactional email and essential monitoring/support

items.task: A unified personal learning home
items.acceptance: Evaluate surfacing existing bookmarks, study sets, course progress and weak topics in one uncluttered resume view, with revision-aware progress and minimal agreed learner data.

items.task: Goal-oriented learning pathways and spaced review
items.acceptance: Evaluate short approved pathways for intended learner levels and optional spaced practice, using existing tours/quizzes rather than multiplying navigation tabs; owner defines curriculum/assessment validity.

items.task: Clear reviewed-coverage and version indicators
items.acceptance: Evaluate concise draft/reviewed/partial/unavailable badges and a quiet change history for the actual published version; avoid prominent warning clutter and never imply approval from references alone.

items.task: Contextual error reporting and reviewer triage
items.acceptance: Evaluate an issue action that captures non-patient structure/topic/source/version context and reproducible steps, linking to existing corrections/review tools without exposing private scans or answers.

items.task: A compact body map and discoverable keyboard shortcuts
items.acceptance: Evaluate an optional collapsed body-map/command entry for regions and commands; keep the current simple region picker and primary four modes, and test whether the addition genuinely reduces navigation effort.

items.task: Reviewed diagrammatic plates and non-WebGL learning fallback
items.acceptance: Evaluate original source-derived labelled 2D plates with compatible notices and radiologist review, suitable for revision or hardware fallback. Do not pass AI-generated anatomical artwork off as validated anatomy.

items.acceptance: Evaluate explicit private-radiology/Atlas, institutional and full-platform profiles so unrelated WSI/live-classroom work does not silently become an initial Atlas blocker; applicable privacy/security/clinical gates cannot be waived by changing a flag.
